content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Dallas

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and hours requirement before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® training course. Our classes are scheduled flexibly to fit working professionals' calendars across Dallas's banking, technology, healthcare, and logistics sectors. You'll complete the PMI-required contact hours through interactive online sessions.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35 contact hours, submit your PMP® application directly to PMI, detailing your project-management experience and education. Pay the PMI examination fee at the time of application. Our team can guide you through the submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study materials, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam with Pearson VUE and take it at a testing center or approved remote location on your timeline.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or published work. Renew your credential before expiration to keep it active and demonstrate current project-management expertise.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
